start: A member's page; the gym has an entry machine; this member has no machine number

steps.action: Find the 'Entry machine' card
user_sees: 'No machine number yet.'
Button 'Give a number'
must_not: The card on the page of an archived member

steps.action: Tap 'Give a number'
user_sees: Sheet 'Machine number for <name>'
Box 'Machine number' already filled with a free number
Buttons 'Save number' and 'Cancel'
must_not: A number offered that another member already has

steps.action: Tap 'Save number'
user_sees: 'Saving…'
A short message starting 'Saved.' that says how to enrol the finger or face on the machine with that number
The card reads 'Machine number: <n>' with the enrol line under it
must_not: Two members with the same number
The number shown on the card but not saved

start: A member's page; the member already has a machine number

steps.action: Tap 'Change number'
user_sees: The sheet with the present number in the box
must_not: An empty box

steps.action: Type another free number, tap 'Save number'
user_sees: 'Saved. Enrol the finger or face again on the machine with number <n>.'
The card shows the new number
must_not: The old number still letting the member in
The old number given away with no word that the finger must be enrolled again

start: Machine number sheet; and pages where the card must not show

steps.action: Type letters or a space, tap 'Save number'
user_sees: 'Type a machine number from 1 to 999999999, with no letters or spaces.'
must_not: Letters dropped and the rest saved

steps.action: Type a number another member has, tap 'Save number'
user_sees: 'Number <n> is already <that member>’s. Pick another number.'
must_not: The other member's number taken from them

steps.action: Open a member's page in a gym with no entry machine, and the page of an archived member
user_sees: No 'Entry machine' card
must_not: A card that offers a number that no machine will use

start: A member's page; the member has a machine number

steps.action: Tap 'Change number', leave the number as it is, tap 'Save number'
user_sees: The sheet closes; no message; nothing changed
must_not: A 'Saved' message and a re-enrol instruction when nothing changed

steps.action: Tap 'Change number', then 'Cancel'
user_sees: The card still shows the old number
must_not: A typed number kept without saving

steps.action: Type a number that is taken
user_sees: The message names the member of this gym who has it
must_not: A member of another gym named
A fingerprint or face picture shown or sent to MettleUp
